'''Sal Dakron''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] officer of the [[Corellian Security Force]] living on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3639 BBY]], he and a few other Corellian resistance members fought against Imperial forces and the [[Coronas]] gang of former councilor [[Harmon Torvix]] in the [[Black Hole (Corellia)|Black Hole]] region of the [[Labor Valley]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sal Dakron appears in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC in the Black Hole, involved in the quest "Corellia Rising."
